correctness.rationale: For every k>=1 and all petal lengths>=3, a local alternating edge-colour sequence realizes difference-one spoke colours on even petals and difference-two on odd petals. Parity-separated hub pairing covers exactly 2k colours for an even number of odd petals; for an odd number, uses 2k+1 colours including one hub pendant. All spectra are consecutive, all edges proper and all colours used. Eulerian incidence parity obstructs all unaugmented odd-s cases. Degree gives optimal palette; published deficiency ordering yields both local exact values. Construction checker validated 5800 actual graphs. Tests corroborate, not replace, the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: A natural complete classification covers arbitrary bouquets with heterogeneous cycle lengths; it supplies a sharp parity boundary, a uniform one-edge optimal hub-localized repair, and minimum spectrum width at the unique high-degree vertex. This resolves exact ordinary deficiency, not only an existing generic obstruction or weaker local estimate. Explicit lengths and placement matter for a constructive edge-scheduling solution. The result does not assert a cactus-wide theorem or a standalone novel bound already implied by outerplanar weak-local results.
